# Prospective component development bootstrap retry

This five-file upload preserves the exact original development job, core, environment helper and GPU worker. Its only new upload file is the separately pinned `qwen_kaggle_bootstrap.py`. The deployment receipt binds the launch script, adapter, tests, installer wheel, original freeze/job and [first failed setup](../qwen_components_development_setup_v1/README.md) before a saved retry. No numeric ranking or quality grade existed when this transport was prepared.

The new orchestration creates a default isolated installer with `venv --without-pip`, verifies the exact official pip 25.2 wheel before execution, installs the same four package versions without dependencies into a private overlay, then starts the unchanged original base-Python worker. The worker still checks active dependencies, package locations and CUDA before weights. This adds new executed bootstrap code; it does not rewrite the original three-file binding or claim that the entire executed program is unchanged. Missing or incompatible dependencies still stop the run. No paid fallback is available.

Upload only `kaggle-upload.zip` to a private Kaggle dataset named **Qwen Components Development Bootstrap v2**, attach it to the existing private notebook, then import `submission.py` from the exact published commit URL. Verify the imported source by exporting the draft before one finite **Save & Run All (Commit)** with GPU enabled and the interactive draft off. Retain its bootstrap audit and stage logs alongside the original worker audit, installer report, checkpoint, numeric output, printed payload hash and saved version.

The original licensed public passages and synthetic query/project identifiers are unchanged from the [original four-file archive](../qwen_components_development_job_v1/README.md), including its attribution and source notices. No review ledger, gold, clinical record, credentials or account/session data is included. Confirmation questions remain unseen by the coordinator. Source truth, model pins, candidate/display budgets and quality gates remain fixed. Preparation and software checks do not establish cloud compatibility or pilot readiness.

The pip wheel is pinned from [official PyPI metadata](https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/25.2/json). Its [vendor entry point](https://github.com/pypa/pip/blob/25.2/src/pip/__main__.py) supports direct wheel execution; [Python venv documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.13/library/venv.html) documents skipping pip bootstrapping.
